title: José Martí: the writer who prepared Cuba's war of independence
goal: Report what José Martí wrote and did, using reported speech and the right tense shifts.

items: I can report what someone said or wrote, shifting the tenses (*quería*, *había escrito*, *haría*).
I can tell the main events of Martí's life in order.
I can use the new words for exile, essays and letters.
